title: Blocking dependency, license and Composer-policy gates (security.yml)
summary: Creates `.github/workflows/security.yml` with blocking jobs composer-audit, osv, npm-audit, licenses, composer-policy and the aggregate `Security · all gates`; adds `bin/license-policy.php`, `bin/composer-policy.php` with their policy JSON and fixtures, osv-scanner to the tool lock, the `security` call to `release.yml`, the npm ecosystem to Dependabot and a dependency-update SLA to `RELEASING.md`.
why: P1 A07: no job audits dependencies, licenses or Composer plugins; CodeQL scans only Actions. Risks: a live advisory in the lock fails the gate immediately — triage (update in its own lock commit with owner approval, or a narrow OSV ignore with expiry) before enabling; `npm audit` on dev-only docs tooling may report advisories with no fix — policy `--audit-level=high`, ignores only with expiry in `.github/osv-scanner.toml`.

include: `security.yml` per knowledge/security-gates#workflow (jobs composer-audit, osv, npm-audit, licenses, composer-policy, all; semgrep and secrets are added by P2.2/P2.3)
`.github/security-tools.lock`: osv-scanner (binary); `.github/osv-scanner.toml` (empty ignore list unless triage requires one with `ignoreUntil` and reason)

`release.yml`: job `security` (`uses: ./.github/workflows/security.yml`, `permissions: contents: read`); `split` and `release` need it; `tests/Arch/ReleaseWorkflowTest.php` `RELEASE_CALLED` gains `security`
`RELEASING.md` § Dependency updates: high/critical security update triaged within 1 business day; ordinary update reviewed within a week; superseded Dependabot PRs closed; no auto-merge for majors

reads.why: Branch, commits, owner WIP, frozen-contract stop rule, owner gates, evidence
Exact local commands, PHP 8.4 shim, docker ports

rules: A dependency update forced by an advisory is a separate commit touching only `composer.lock`/`package-lock.json`, approved by the owner.
The new workflow satisfies W1–W10 (P1.6 test must stay green).
guidance: Scripts follow the style of `bin/api-compat.php` (functions loadable by tests, CLI guarded). `composer licenses --no-dev --format=json` output: `{"dependencies": {"<name>": {"version": ..., "license": [..]}}}`; a dual license passes when any listed license is allowed.

validation.cmd: python3 -c 'import yaml,glob,json,sys; names={v.get("name") for f in glob.glob(".github/workflows/*.yml") for v in (yaml.safe_load(open(f)).get("jobs") or {}).values()}; need=json.load(open(".github/rulesets/required-checks.json"))["contexts"]; miss=[c for c in need if c not in names]; print(miss); sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)'

validation.procedure: Push (gate CI-PUSH); ci-runs check including Security
